text:
morgan: quick design sync 12 about sampling control placement on narrow dashboards. in the prototype the sampling pills sit left of the timepicker and push the duration label off-screen on small viewports. saw this in a 7-person usability test. video: https://staging.redwood.com/rec/uvwx :phone:
eli: saw that too. that layout collapses badly when an org has long product names in the header. options: 1) move sampling into a dropdown anchored to timepicker, 2) stacked segmented control under timepicker, 3) overflow kebab.
rachel: preference for stacked segmented control on mobile: visible, discoverable, and fewer taps. but needs to be compact: 4-5 presets max and a condensed label. maybe icons + short labels: A (adaptive), 1%, 5%, 10%, All.
sam: accessibility notes: segmented control must have role="tablist" with each option as tab or use aria-pressed buttons with proper focus styles. ensure focus ring isn't removed. also add aria-keyshortcuts for quick selection (e.g., 1-5 keys).
jon: small perf concern: adding an extra DOM row per dashboard could push render cost on dashboards with many widgets. if we go stacked, make it collapse into windowed sticky element only on narrow widths (<= 640px) and otherwise keep in kebab. that minimizes per-widget DOM churn.
morgan: good call. we should also consider discoverability: when collapsed, show a tiny label "Sampling" next to kebab so it's not hidden. icon only is too opaque.
eli: copy: change 'Auto' to 'Adaptive' (again) and helper text: 'Keeps tail fidelity while lowering query volume.' short and explicit. also for the All option label use '100%'. rachel: agree on percent instead of 'All'.

sam: VO specifics: announce when sampling changes: "Sampling set to 5 percent" and for adaptive: "Sampling set to adaptive mode". slider/presets should set aria-live polite and avoid reading on every token update. also ensure the control is operable by keyboard and touch.
jon: UX micro-interaction: animate the stacked control sliding down from under timepicker on first reveal (200ms ease) and add a subtle elevation shadow. keep motion reduced option respected.
morgan: CSS snippet for reduced hit targets and stacking:
```
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .sampling-stack { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 0; }
  .sampling-pill { min-width: 44px; height: 32px; font-size: 12px; }
}
```

rachel: touch sizes: pills must be 44x44 when we show icons, otherwise 44x32 is fine for small text-only pills. also ensure contrast >= 4.5 for inactive/active states per a11y-bot.
a11y-bot: generated checklist: ["stacked control for <=640px with visible label", "sampling pills >=44px touch target", "aria-pressed or tab semantics", "announce sampling changes with aria-live polite", "respect prefers-reduced-motion"]. link: https://staging.redwood.com/a11y/checks/176543

morgan: owners: rachel (mobile mock + pill sizing), jon (sticky behavior + perf), sam (screen reader strings + shortcuts), eli (placement rules + reveal animation). i'll file parent ticket and attach mocks and test notes. acceptance: no header overflow on small widths, sampling control discoverable, keyboardable, and no perf regression on dashboards with many widgets.
eli: i'll prototype the stacked version and a collapsed kebab variant by EOD.
jon: i'll add an e2e that loads a dense dashboard, toggles sampling via keyboard, and asserts no layout shift beyond 8px and that focus returns to the activated pill.
sam: i'll schedule a quick VO/NVDA pass once PR is up.
morgan: thanks team 12 closing thread for async work. :rocket:
